siblings.summary: Shortlist of distinctive places to stay within a 0-17 km taxi hop of schanz. in Piesport, with notes on the rural-Mosel taxi situation.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of schanz. restaurant.
siblings.summary: Strict 30 km from Schanz: almost nothing. Trier (34 km by road) is the only real hub - and in late July it hosts the CiE/MCU/CCA/GSW cluster.

sources.title: Moselsteig Stage 8 Leiwen-Neumagen-Dhron
sources.claim: Stage 8 is a vineyard-and-rock-cliff stage ending in Germany's oldest wine town at the Stella Noviomagi.

sources.title: Moselsteig trail stages overview
sources.claim: Moselsteig stage lengths: 8 = 14.09 km, 9 = 17.97 km, 10 = 14.69 km, 11 = 16.99 km, 7 = 14.50 km.

sources.title: Moselsteig Stage 11 Bernkastel-Kues-Ürzig
sources.claim: Stage 11 is 16.7 km with +684 m, difficult, 5.5-6 h.

sources.title: Calmont Klettersteig (visitmosel.de)
sources.claim: Calmont Klettersteig is 3.54 km, ~1.5 h, medium difficulty, ~40-50 km drive from Piesport.

sources.title: Calmont Klettersteig (official)
sources.claim: Calmont rises 380 m with up to 65° incline - Europe's steepest vineyard, secured with ladders, ropes and step irons.

sources.title: Piesporter Moselbogen Leuchtpunkt
sources.claim: Piesporter Moselbogen loop is 7.98 km, ~2 h 15, easy, +105 m / -205 m through the Goldtröpfchen.

sources.title: Zummethöhe panorama viewpoint
sources.claim: Zummethöhe panorama was voted 'Best of the Vineyard Views Moselle' 2016; Kronenberg + Sonnenberg loops join into a 15 km trail.

sources.title: Fünf-Seen-Blick
sources.claim: Fünf-Seen-Blick is a 23 m freely accessible wooden tower with 105 steps and views over the Moselle to the Eifel.

sources.title: Römersteig premium trail
sources.claim: Römersteig: 22.26 km Trittenheim-Minheim, +435 m, difficult, crossing two ferries past Roman sites.

sources.title: Panorama-Wanderweg Piesport
sources.claim: Panorama-Wanderweg Piesport is a ~5 km loop from Heiligenhäuschen with a 180° viewpoint over Piesport, Minheim and Neumagen-Dhron.

sources.title: Weingut Reinhold Haart
sources.claim: Reinhold Haart in Piesport farms 9 ha of Mosel steep slope including the Goldtröpfchen, tastings by appointment.

sources.title: Weingut Fritz Haag
sources.claim: Fritz Haag in Brauneberg farms 19.5 ha including Brauneberger Juffer and Juffer Sonnenuhr; tastings pre-arranged by email.

sources.title: Weingut Nik Weis - St. Urbans-Hof
sources.claim: Nik Weis in Leiwen offers bookable tastings of Rieslings from 5 VDP.Grosse Lage sites including a view over Laurentiuslay.

sources.title: Vinothek St-Nikolaus-Hospital
sources.claim: St-Nikolaus-Hospital Vinothek is the world's largest Mosel-Riesling vinothek, daily 10-18, €30 walk-in tasting over 100 wines.

sources.title: Weingut Schloss Lieser
sources.claim: Schloss Lieser opens Mon-Tue/Thu-Fri 10-17, Sat 11-15; full tastings by email; no cellar or vineyard tours.

sources.title: Piesport Mosel wine guide
sources.claim: In-village wine venues in Piesport: Vinothek Piesport, Weinhaus Hoffmann, Weinbar am Markt.

sources.title: Weingut Clüsserath-Weiler
sources.claim: Clüsserath-Weiler in Trittenheim opens Mon-Fri 8-18, Sat-Sun 8-13 for walk-in tasting in the old barrel cellar.

sources.title: Römische Kelteranlage Piesport-Niederemmel
sources.claim: Reconstructed Roman wine press at Ausoniusufer, freely accessible; annual wine-press festival in early October.

sources.title: Stella Noviomagi
sources.claim: Stella Noviomagi: largest seaworthy reconstructed Roman ship in the German-speaking world, 17.95 m; Sat 16:00 cultural cruises May-Oct 2026.

sources.title: Neumagener Römerweinschiff
sources.claim: Neumagen-Dhron is the oldest wine village in Germany; the c. 220 AD wine-ship tomb sculpture excavated 1878 from the late-Roman fortress wall.

sources.title: Burg Landshut
sources.claim: Burg Landshut sits on a 60 m rocky ledge above Bernkastel-Kues, built 1276 atop a 4th-5th c. Roman fort; reached by shuttle (Apr-Oct) or a 30-min walk.

sources.title: St-Nikolaus-Hospital / Cusanusstift
sources.claim: Cusanusstift founded 1465 as hospice for 33 elderly men; library viewable only Tue 10:30 / Fri 15:00 Apr-Oct.

sources.title: Moselweinmuseum Kues
sources.claim: Moselweinmuseum Kues: daily 10-17 Apr-Oct, 14-17 winter; attached Vinothek with ~140 Mosel-Saar-Ruwer wines.

sources.title: Spitzhäuschen Bernkastel
sources.claim: Spitzhäuschen built 1416 with narrow base and jettied upper floors because taxes were charged on ground footprint.

sources.title: Burg Veldenz
sources.claim: Veldenz castle, largest on the Central Mosel in the 15th c., razed by Louis XIV in 1681; guided tours Wed 15:00 Apr-Oct, €8.

sources.title: Villa Rustica Mehring
sources.claim: Villa Rustica Mehring: 48 × 29 m Gallo-Roman estate, 34 rooms, heated bath complex, mosaic floors; free year-round, tours Sun 11:30 Apr-Oct.

sources.title: Villa Urbana Longuich
sources.claim: Villa Urbana Longuich: luxurious Roman country retreat with own baths; tours May-Oct Sun 10:30.

sources.title: Städtische Galerie Wittlich (Meistermann)
sources.claim: Wittlich Städtische Galerie shows Georg Meistermann stained-glass and paintings, Tue-Sat 11-17, Sun 14-17, €1.

sources.title: Wittlicher Säubrennerkirmes 2026
sources.claim: Säubrennerkirmes runs 14-18 August 2026; Saturday parade and ceremonial roast-pork carving on the Marktplatz.

sources.title: Laurentiuskapelle Trittenheim
sources.claim: Trittenheim's Laurentiuskapelle first documented 1569, restored 1997-99; village preserves the only surviving pair of pontoon-ferry towers on the Mosel between Perl and Koblenz (1829-1908).

sources.title: Personenschifffahrt Gebr. Kolb (Moselrundfahrten)
sources.claim: Kolb Bernkastel-region cruises May-Oct 2026 on Tue/Thu/Sat (plus Wed Aug-Sep); Leiwen-Bernkastel arrival noon, return 15:00; adult return €27.

sources.title: Moselradweg Stage 5 Piesport-Bernkastel
sources.claim: Moselradweg Stage 5 Piesport to Bernkastel-Kues is 18.5 km along the right bank, mostly flat, past Moselloreley.

sources.title: Piesport tourist info - bike rental
sources.claim: Bike rental in Piesport: Fahrradverleih Peter Später, Altes Kelterhaus; tourist office has e-bike charging.

sources.title: Mosel-Kanu-Service Piesport
sources.claim: Mosel-Kanu-Service in Piesport rents canoes and kayaks for the Piesport loop and Wintrich barrage reservoir.

sources.title: Waldkletterpark Leiwen
sources.claim: Waldkletterpark Wald Abenteuer Leiwen in the Landal resort: adult €29, under-18 €25, kids €18; min 140 cm / 11 yrs adult course.

sources.title: Moseltherme Traben-Trarbach
sources.claim: Moseltherme: thermal pool (32°C), multi-purpose pool, outdoor pool plus sauna landscape (steam, Finnish, salt room).

sources.title: Moseltherme hours / prices
sources.claim: Moseltherme bath area: Mon 14-21, Tue-Fri 9-21, Sat-Sun 9-18; bath day €4-€7.50, bath + sauna day €17.

sources.title: Vulkaneifel Therme Bad Bertrich
sources.claim: Vulkaneifel Therme: thermal bath daily 9-22; closed 15-28 June 2026 for maintenance.

sources.title: Vinothek im Cusanusstift
sources.claim: Vinothek im Cusanusstift offers 160+ Mosel wines and Sekt; tasting flight 120-160 wines €15; entry without tasting free.

sources.title: Cusanusstift Library
sources.claim: Cusanusstift library holds ~314 manuscripts and 132 incunabula; one of the most valuable private medieval collections in Europe.

sources.title: Kloster Machern brewery
sources.claim: Kloster Machern complex opposite Zeltingen-Rachtig: working monastery brewery, wine cellar and bistro with Moselle and vineyard views.

sources.title: Brennerei Beth Kröv
sources.claim: Weingut & Brennerei Hans Beth in Kröv: Mosel Edelbrände since 1991, daily shop in season 10-18, tastings of fruit brandies, Mosel Gin.

sources.title: Käse-/Elfengrotte Bad Bertrich
sources.claim: Elfengrotte (Käsegrotte) at Bad Bertrich: basalt-lava cave with cheese-wheel column formations and small waterfall, 2.4 km easy trail.

sources.title: Moselschlösschen Day Spa
sources.claim: Moselschlösschen Spa & Resort Traben-Trarbach: day spa 8-20 €98 pp, 2,500 m² wellness with infinity pool and 6 saunas.

sources.title: Mittelmosel-Museum Villa Böcking
sources.claim: Mittelmosel-Museum in baroque Villa Böcking, Traben-Trarbach: Tue-Fri 10-17, Sat-Sun 12-16, 2 Apr - 1 Nov 2026.

sources.title: Weinfest der Mittelmosel
sources.claim: Weinfest der Mittelmosel Bernkastel-Kues: 3-7 September 2026; Saturday fireworks, Sunday parade, 20+ Mosel communities on a 300 m wine route.

sources.title: Bernkastel-Kues tourism
sources.claim: Bernkastel-Kues: medieval twin town, half-timbered Marktplatz, 1416 Spitzhäuschen, 1608 Renaissance Town Hall, Doctor vineyard.

sources.title: Traben-Trarbach Art Nouveau
sources.claim: Traben-Trarbach is celebrated for Art Nouveau architecture introduced by Bruno Möhring c. 1900, including the Bridge Gate.

sources.title: Traben-Trarbach official tourism
sources.claim: Traben-Trarbach was the second-largest wine-trading hub in Europe in the late 19th c., leaving grand Art Nouveau villas and tour-able underground cellars.

sources.title: Mosel-Wein-Nachts-Markt
sources.claim: Mosel-Wein-Nachts-Markt in historic underground wine cellars Traben-Trarbach: 20 Nov 2026 - 2 Jan 2027, Fri-Sun.

sources.title: Trittenheim
sources.claim: Trittenheim wraps a tight Moselschleife hairpin, shares the Piesporter Michelsberg appellation with Apotheke and Altärchen Grosse Lagen.

sources.title: Zeltingen-Rachtig
sources.claim: Zeltingen-Rachtig: 133 ha of vines, Grosse Lage Zeltinger Sonnenuhr on southwest-facing blue Devonian slate.

sources.title: Ürzig
sources.claim: Ürzig has the highest steep-vineyard share of any German wine town, red-volcanic Würzgarten, oldest sundial in the Mosel valley.

sources.title: Brauneberg tourism
sources.claim: Brauneberg: Brauneberger Juffer Grosse Lage on some of Germany's warmest slopes, 2.2 km walnut-tree avenue, leaning tower of St. Remigius, reconstructed Roman wine press.

sources.title: Burg Veldenz (visitmosel)
sources.claim: Mülheim is gateway to Schloss Veldenz, the former largest castle of the Central Moselle; guided tours Wed 15:00 Apr-Oct; working trebuchet on site.

sources.title: Wittlich Marktplatz
sources.claim: Wittlich's historic Marktplatz: 1652 Renaissance Old Town Hall (now city gallery), Baroque Church of St. Markus, Renaissance and Baroque townhouses.
